name: Stöcklenalm
beschreibung: The Stöcklenalm alpine lodge is perched at approximately 1,500 metres above sea level in the Tyrolean Alps, close to the Ötztal valley. The youth hostel offers simple, welcoming accommodation with authentic alpine charm and sweeping views over the surrounding mountain scenery. Guests stay in multi-bed rooms or dormitories, while the on-site restaurant serves wholesome regional cuisine. The lodge serves as an ideal base for scenic hikes and ambitious mountain ascents throughout the area.
